notes.title: The New Video Suite 2024 Is Here to Save the Day!
notes.content:
Celebrate the new Movavi Video Suite with the new features:

- Revamped timeline
The new timeline is now clearer and more streamlined. Get your projects done faster and have more fun with any types of videos.

 - Frame-precise cuts in a click
Give your videos a sharper look with the new video-cutting tool. Easily make precise cuts and create eye-catching montages.

- Perfect-match overlay effects
Now each overlay effect has 13 blending modes to choose from. Try each of them  and pick the one that fits your video perfectly.

- Pro-quality color correction
Get next-level color correction with the same simplicity. Boost colors in a snap and make more viewers fall in love with your videos.

- 8x upscaling
Give what you’ve shot this summer a serious facelift and make your vids’ resolution 8 times higher.

- Our best effects – at your fingertips
Create awesome videos in any style with the new collection of professionally designed effects. 

Get Adventure Colors Gift Pack for Free!

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2690340/header.jpg?t=1702920885

If you already have some effects packs for Movavi Video Suite 2023 you can get them for the new 2024 version for free — they will be available in your Steam Library.

These are:
Cinematic Set, Timeless Pack, Rule Your Game Music Pack, Good Game Pack, Let's Play Pack, Action Pack, Digital Overlay Pack, Cyberpunk Overlay Pack,  My Channel Pack for YouTube #2
